title: Show Panel
summary: Opens the dockable Live Coordination panel: rule pass rate, violation rows, ⚡ Fix buttons and the Doctor log.
steps: Click Sentinel ▸ Coordinate ▸ Show Panel.
Read the pass rate and the violation rows; BLOCK rows are listed first.
Double-click a row to zoom to the element.
Press ⚡ Fix on a row to open the fix dialog.
notes: Live scanning runs in the background; the panel shows its results as you model.
The Doctor strip lists benign Revit warnings Sentinel resolved for you.

title: Change Requests
summary: Coordinator review of pending modeller changes and ⚡ Fix proposals.
steps: Click Coordinate ▸ Change Requests.
Select a request and press Show to isolate the element.
Approve to keep a change or apply a proposal.
Reject to revert a change or drop a proposal.
notes: Only users listed as coordinators in %AppData%\Sentinel\settings.json can decide.
The audit trail travels with the model in Extensible Storage.

title: BCF Issues
summary: Reviews coordination issues raised on the web and lets you fix referee issues in place.
steps: Click Coordinate ▸ BCF Issues.
Double-click an issue to zoom to its element and camera.
For an IDS issue, open Fix in Revit and enter the values.
Press Check, then Apply ticked; the issue resolves only when every element passes.
notes: If the bridge is down, a fix reads applied, NOT verified and the issue is not changed.

title: Clash Manager
summary: Native clash detection of linked RVT and IFC MEP against structure, graded Hard, Medium or Soft.
steps: Load the MEP links (RVT or IFC) into the model.
Click Coordinate ▸ Clash ▸ Clash Manager.
Review the severity-coloured list.
Show an element, export BCF, or create a 3D clash view.
notes: Clash views are named CO_MEP-CLASH_* and section-boxed.
Slow on big models; there is no cancel yet.

title: Clash Register
summary: Read-only view of the team-wide clash register recorded on the web.
steps: Click Coordinate ▸ Clash ▸ Clash Register.
Filter by status to follow each clash's lifecycle.
Use the web app to change a clash's status.
notes: The model must be bound to a web project (Project Setup).

title: Review Flag
summary: One-time setup that creates the ZZZ_ReviewStatus parameter on views, sheets, levels and grids.
steps: Open the central model as coordinator.
Click Coordinate ▸ Review Flag.
Create a Browser Organization scheme that groups by ZZZ_ReviewStatus.
notes: Run it once per model; Change Requests uses this flag.

title: Review AI Proposals
summary: Reviews staged AI element proposals with the referee's verdict per element.
steps: Click Coordinate ▸ Review AI Proposals.
Pick a changeset and read each element's verdict.
Tick the elements you accept.
Apply; only ticked elements enter the model.
notes: Every decision is audit-chained on the ledger.
Ghost Builder, Photo Massing, Shell a Mass and Promote file their changesets here.

title: Scan Now
summary: Runs a full compliance scan against the document's active ruleset.
steps: Open a project document (not a family).
Click Validate ▸ Scan Now.
Review the results in the Sentinel panel.
notes: The ruleset is re-resolved first; an unchanged one is a cheap check.

title: Health Scorecard
summary: A weighted 0–100 compliance score with an A–F grade and per-domain breakdown.
steps: Click Validate ▸ Health Scorecard.
Read the overall grade.
Use the per-domain breakdown to find where points are lost.
notes: Weights: block 8, request 4, warn 2, monitor 0.5.

title: Rule Set
summary: Shows the ruleset this document is judged by, with its source and sha.
steps: Click Validate ▸ Rule Set.
Browse the rule cards: mode, token patterns, messages, whitelists.
Check the source line to see where the ruleset came from.
notes: Rulesets are installed on the web project or its office, never on this PC.

title: IFC Pre-Flight
summary: Audits IFC export mappings and the contract's required properties before you export.
steps: Click Validate ▸ IFC Gate ▸ IFC Pre-Flight.
Read the summary dialog.
Fix the IFC-01 / IFC-02 rows listed in the panel.
Re-run until clean, then export or run the Delivery Gate.
notes: Generic Models and Specialty Equipment are warned: they export as proxies.
With no contract installed, required properties are listed as not checked.

title: IFC Delivery Gate
summary: Exports and certifies an IFC against the project's delivery contract: PASS, FAIL or NOT CHECKED.
steps: Make sure the model is bound (Project Setup).
Click Validate ▸ IFC Gate ▸ IFC Delivery Gate.
Export the active 3D view, or pick an existing .ifc.
Read the verdict and the ledger line; FAIL means do not upload.
notes: A signed .sentinel-cert.json is written beside the IFC.
No contract installed means NOT CHECKED, never a pass.

title: Sanitize .rfa
summary: Audits an .rfa before loading: geometry budget, nested CAD, shared parameters, unnamed types.
steps: Click Validate ▸ Family Health ▸ Sanitize .rfa.
Pick the .rfa file.
Read the audit; the family loads only on a pass.
notes: The solid budget is 150 solids.

title: Heal Loaded Families
summary: Scans loaded families and silently injects missing shared parameters.
steps: Click Validate ▸ Family Health ▸ Heal Loaded Families.
Wait for the scan; healable families reload automatically.
Review the families flagged as requiring human interaction.
notes: Geometry and CAD problems are flagged, never touched.
Each run writes one family_heal ledger row.

title: MEP Openings
summary: Finds linked MEP and structure intersections and places tracked provision-for-void families.
steps: Load the MEP link.
Click Validate ▸ MEP Openings.
Review candidates; nearby ones merge within 150 mm.
Place voids, or export the set as BCF.
notes: Re-runs relocate moved voids, flag deleted ones Orphaned and never touch status Cut.

title: MEP Type Check
summary: Checks ducts, pipes, cable trays and conduits against the project's type catalogue.
steps: Click Validate ▸ MEP Type Check.
Review mismatched type names and system types.
Optionally save the BCF topic file.
notes: Reads only; no size check and no retype.
One ledger row per check.

title: Naming Manager
summary: Reviews family and type names against the office naming rules and renames what you tick.
steps: Click Validate ▸ Naming Manager.
Read each row: current name, proposed name and why.
Tick the rows to rename.
Apply; the status line shows the ledger row.
notes: Duplicates are blocked, never suffixed.
Proposals are recovered from the name and measured width, never guessed.

title: Governed Publish
summary: The one publish path: export IFC, run the delivery gate, adjudicate, and register a version on pass.
steps: Bind the model to its web project (Project Setup).
Click Publish ▸ Governed Publish.
Wait for export, gate and adjudication.
Read the dialog: the version, its verdict and both ledger rows.
notes: A reject uploads nothing; each failing requirement opens as a BCF issue.
A registered version is wip until a lead shares it on the web.

title: Publish Sheets
summary: Renders all sheets to PNG for the web app's Sheets tab.
steps: Click Publish ▸ Publish ▸ Publish Sheets.
Wait for the progress window to finish.
Open the web app's Sheets tab.
notes: Outside the governed IFC path: no version and no verdict.

title: Publish Views
summary: Publishes the views you choose to the web app's Views tab.
steps: Click Publish ▸ Publish ▸ Publish Views.
Tick plans, sections, elevations, 3D or drafting views.
Publish; only ticked views appear on the web.
notes: Outside the governed IFC path: no version and no verdict.

title: Project Setup
summary: Binds this model to its web project, which supplies its ruleset, IDS and naming.
steps: Click Standards ▸ Project Setup.
Choose the web project for this model.
Set the template path and save.
notes: Most governed tools need a bound model.

title: Sign in
summary: Signs in with your Sentinel account so governed calls carry your name on the ledger.
steps: Click Standards ▸ Sign in.
Enter the same account you use on the web.
Use Sign out to forget it on this PC.
notes: Without sign-in, calls use this PC's shared token.

title: Build Office System
summary: Extracts worksets and shared parameters from a golden model and builds them into this one.
steps: Open the golden model.
Click Standards ▸ Build Office System and review the extract.
Build it into the target model; it is enforced in the ruleset.

title: Apply Standard
summary: Loads a saved standards pack and builds it into the active model.
steps: Open the blank or target model.
Click Standards ▸ Apply Standard.
Pick the standards pack and confirm.

title: Ingest Docs
summary: Reads standards documents with a local LLM into a reviewable standards pack.
steps: Start Ollama on this PC.
Click Standards ▸ Ingest Docs and pick PDF, text or CSV files.
Review the extracted worksets and parameters, then save the pack.
notes: Requires Ollama; nothing leaves the PC.

title: 1 · Datum from Drawings
summary: Creates levels and grids measured off imported section and plan drawings.
steps: Import a section with a levels layer and a plan with a grid layer.
Click Model from Drawings ▸ 1 · Datum from Drawings.
Pick the layers and review the levels and grids.
Create them.
notes: Do this before modelling any element.

title: 2 · Ghost Builder
summary: Builds LOD 200 geometry from a 2D DWG import using the project's layers standard.
steps: Import the DWG plan.
Click Model from Drawings ▸ 2 · Ghost Builder.
Map CAD layers; suggestions are never pre-ticked.
File the changeset and apply it in Review AI Proposals.
notes: Walls are typed by the project's guideline and type catalogue.

title: 2b · Photo Massing
summary: Reads storey counts and proportions from admitted photos and files a mass for review.
steps: Click Model from Drawings ▸ 2b · Photo Massing.
Pick where the mass stands (its footprint).
Type one known height or width and press Scale.
Review and file the changeset; apply it in Review AI Proposals.
notes: Photos give counts and ratios, not lengths.

title: 2c · Shell a Mass
summary: Cuts a mass at each storey level into typed walls, floors and a roof, filed for review.
steps: Select a mass.
Click Model from Drawings ▸ 2c · Shell a Mass.
Read the plan (No = read-only).
File the changeset and apply it in Review AI Proposals.
notes: A storey that leans or is not one straight-edged loop goes to a person.

title: 3 · Annotate Views
summary: Creates the guideline's plan views and pins levels and grids.
steps: Click Model from Drawings ▸ 3 · Annotate Views.
Review the preview of views and pins.
Tick what to write and confirm.
notes: Written as one Sentinel Undo entry.
No guideline installed means nothing to plan.

title: 4 · Promote (DD)
summary: Promotes walls, floors, roofs, ceilings, doors and windows to DD by the guideline and LOD matrix.
steps: Click Model from Drawings ▸ 4 · Promote (DD).
Read the plan (No = read-only).
Review ambiguous elements sent to a person.
File the changesets, one per storey.
notes: No type is ever created; only loaded catalogue types are used.

title: 5 · Provenance
summary: Shows where an element came from: source, file sha, CAD layer, rule, approver and ledger row.
steps: Select an element.
Click Model from Drawings ▸ 5 · Provenance.
Read its provenance stamp.
notes: A copied stamp reads copied, not placed by Sentinel.
Reads only.

title: ROI Dashboard
summary: Counts gate runs, renames and family heals from the project ledger, priced by the roi standard.
steps: Bind the model (Project Setup).
Click Standards & Build ▸ ROI Dashboard.
Read the counts; money shows only with roi@n installed.
notes: Tools that write no ledger row are listed as not counted.
